purpose: Observed TTC, Fair Pass, transit-service and census context for the UTSC-area fare demo. Extends data/toronto_demo_baseline.json without changing it. No simulated results, elasticities or behavioural coefficients.
scenario: Hypothetical +$0.50 adult TTC fare, with Fair Pass as a policy lever (eligibility, discount, enrollment friction)

budget_social_development_2026.publisher: City of Toronto, BudgetTO 2026 Budget Notes: Social Development
budget_social_development_2026.location: page 5, How Well We Are Doing table

budget_ttc_2026.publisher: City of Toronto, BudgetTO 2026 Budget Notes: Toronto Transit Commission

ttc_gtfs.publisher: Toronto Transit Commission via City of Toronto Open Data

ttc_route_ridership_2016.publisher: Toronto Transit Commission via City of Toronto Open Data

spt_fare_capping_2026.use_limit: Usage figure comes from a TTCriders FOI request; not independently verified

fare_rules.fare_freeze: Fares frozen at 2023 levels for a third consecutive year in the 2026 budget (budget_ttc_2026, p. 9)

monthly_cap.eligible_payment: PRESTO card, debit, credit or mobile wallet; same card or device each time
monthly_cap.planned_change: Cap of 40 fares from 2027 is reported as TTC-Board endorsed (spt_fare_capping_2026); not a current rule

derived_monthly_maximums_cad.note: Computed here as 47 x single fare; not published values except Fair Pass

fare_rules.two_hour_transfer: PRESTO card, PRESTO Ticket, debit/credit; not cash

eligibility.income_rule: Net annual family income below 75% of Statistics Canada LIM-AT (updated February 2026, 2023 data)

fair_pass.discount: 36% off adult single fares; $2.10 vs $3.30, saving $1.20 per ride; applies 12 months; TTC only
application_steps: Have a PRESTO card number (physical card costs $4)
Apply online, by phone (416-338-8888) or in person by appointment (Regent Park, Keele, Scarborough Civic Centre)
OW/ODSP/CCFS: program ID only; others: income proof for all household members (CRA Notice of Assessment, pay stubs, EI/CPP pages, or a support letter)
Missing documents: emailed upload token, 30 days to resubmit
Annual renewal reviews resume 2026-08-01; non-OW/ODSP/CCFS clients may need a new application, notified 45 days before expiry
fair_pass.funding: Phased and subject to annual Council funding

enrollment.column_order_note: PDF text extraction; column order checked against the footnote (2025 projection exceeds target by 2,849,757 rides, 20.4%)
enrollment.budget_context: Provincial reduction to the Ontario Works transportation benefit is creating more dependency on Fair Pass (p. 6)

usage_secondary.note: Under the cap, a Fair Pass rider reaches the $98.70 maximum only after 47 trips

fair_pass.eligible_population: not_estimable from published sources found; do not derive take-up rate. Census LIM-AT prevalence is a different threshold (100% LIM-AT, not 75%) and age band
fair_pass.historical_note: The City estimated about 77,000 people became newly eligible when RGI recipients were added in 2022 (torontohousing.ca news); eligibility estimate, not enrollment

ttc_system.fare_capping_budget_effect: Estimated $3.1M revenue decrease and 2.1M net new free rides in 2026
ttc_system.passenger_revenue_change_2026: Reduced passenger revenues of $34.4M offset by a $35.0M Stabilization Reserve withdrawal
ttc_system.use_limit: System-wide budget figures; never scale the demo sample to these totals

utsc_area_service.method: Trips stopping at any of 19 stops within 600 m of 'Military Trail at University of Toronto Scarborough' (43.785926, -79.186773) on Wednesday 2026-10-14; each trip counted once; AM peak = first area departure 07:00-08:59
utsc_area_service.boardings_note: boardings_2016_all_day is whole-route typical weekday boardings as of 2016-12-31 (ttc_route_ridership_2016), not boardings at UTSC and not current. Route 198 U of T Scarborough Rocket had 6,681 in 2016 and no longer appears in the 2026 feed
utsc_area_service.use_limit: Scheduled trips, not observed ridership, crowding or reliability

neighbourhoods.sample_note: Population, tenure and commuting rows are 25% sample data; low-income prevalence uses LIM-AT (100%), not the Fair Pass 75% threshold

rows.name: Highland Creek
rows.designation: Not an NIA or Emerging Neighbourhood

rows.name: Morningside Heights
rows.designation: Not an NIA or Emerging Neighbourhood

rows.name: Centennial Scarborough
rows.designation: Not an NIA or Emerging Neighbourhood

twin_link.note: Which Twin-2K-500 given/exam modules relate to each TTC decision. Twin is a US survey sample with no transit questions; a Toronto check against the fare papers is still required.

decisions.decision: ride, switch mode or skip a trip after +$0.50
apply for Fair Pass given document and renewal hassle

twin_modules: heuristics-and-biases tasks such as absolute vs relative savings

global_limits: Neighbourhood income and mode counts are separate margins, not joint individual records
Fair Pass take-up rate is not estimable: no published count of eligible residents under the 75% LIM-AT rule was found
No Toronto fare elasticity is established here; use data/ttc_fare_evidence.json cases with their transfer limits
Route boardings are 2016 whole-route figures; scheduled trips are not ridership
Do not scale sample outcomes to the 426.4M system rides or the Fair Pass program totals
